name: Digi Spain Telecom, S.a.
summary: DIGI Spain Telecom, S.A. provides telecommunications network and internet access services in Spain. The company, through a fiber-optic network, offers internet, fixed-line and mobile services, as well as pay TV. It also operates retail stores that sell its services throughout Spain. The company serves residential customers. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Alcobendas, Spain. DIGI Spain Telecom, S.L.U. operates as a subsidiary of Digi Romania S.A
